title: reliab report
description: What one verify run did and found. Written only by reliab. See knowledge/concepts/report.md.

tier.description: on-demand: the commands were chosen with verify --only.

only.description: Commands an on-demand run was asked for.

scope.description: Repo-relative paths an on-demand run was narrowed to.

tests.description: Test runs named with verify --tests, one spec each, opaque to reliab. See knowledge/decisions/named-tests.md.

mutationTests.description: Tests named with verify --mutation-tests for mutation runs, opaque to reliab.

profilePath.description: The profile file the run loaded (verify -f), slash-separated and relative to the repo root unless outside it. Commands that judge the report load it; protection always reads reliability-profile.yaml.

complete.description: False when the budget ran out before every command ran, or a command needed tests named and none were (skip reason needs-input).

head.description: The HEAD commit when the run started, absent in a repository with no commits. Ties history reports to a branch (knowledge/decisions/pr-evidence-summary.md).

base.description: The base ref changed-code commands were measured against, or relevance was judged against, when either happened.

log.description: Captured stdout and stderr, relative to the repo root.

coverage.description: Lines a coverage report measured and how many tests reached; with changedSince, only lines changed since that base ref.

relevance.description: For a command with relevant_when: the changed file that made it relevant, or why relevance was not judged (nightly, --only, no base). See knowledge/decisions/relevance-skips.md.

reason.description: not-relevant: the change touched no file the command's relevant_when names. role-missing: the codebase needs the command's tool role and has no tool for it yet. needs-input: the command needs tests named (its profile needs) and none were, so the run is incomplete.

verdict.description: Written by reliab report verdict for the reviewer subagent. See knowledge/decisions/reviewer-verdict.md.

treeHash.description: The tree the reviewer re-ran; the push gate accepts the verdict only while the report and working tree still have it.

head.description: The commit the reviewer's clean worktree was at.

rerunStartedAt.description: When the reviewer's own pre-PR run started.

mutantCounts.description: Mutants a mutation command tested, after any changed-lines filter: killed (timeouts included), survived, and notCovered (no test reaches the line). Mutants that did not build are not counted. Survived and notCovered mutants are also findings.

changedSince.description: Set when the counts cover only mutants on lines changed since this base ref.

mutantFiles.description: Mutant counts per repo-relative file, when the tool says, so a baseline scope can be scored.

score.description: A mutation command's score: killed of counted, where counted is killed, survived, and not covered, less the survivors a person confirmed equivalent. See knowledge/decisions/mutation-threshold.md.

equivalent.description: Survivors a person confirmed equivalent, left out of counted.

pendingEquivalent.description: Survivors classified equivalent and not yet confirmed; still counted.

threshold.description: The profile's minimum score in percent.

unmeasured.description: The tool reported no per-file counts, so the scope could not be scored.

diffLabel.description: For a text snapshot or capture that no longer matches: additive-only when lines were only added, values-changed when any line was removed or changed. It helps a person review; approval stays human (R2). See knowledge/decisions/snapshot-diff-labels.md.

location.description: File and line, when the tool reports one.

replay.description: Path of the saved seed or input that reproduces it.

message.description: Raw failure text from the tool, truncated.

from.description: Set only when carried: the report the classification was made in, as its tier and run start (e.g. prepr 2026-10-20T08:05:23-07:00).
Set only when carried: the report the acknowledgement was made in, as its tier and run start.

fingerprint.description: For a finding with no test (the command failed as a whole): a hash of its message and observed output without run-to-run noise. Its classification and acknowledgement carry to the next run only while this is the same.

reopened.description: Why an earlier classification or acknowledgement of this finding was not carried: the failure changed, or the earlier report had no fingerprint.
